rows.text:
If you are the greatest treasure hunter in the world,
then congratulations,
you have obtained the most precious fortune in this universe:
an alchemy recipe.
Commit it to your memory, and never let it go.
 
Ingredients:
Two ripe red tomatoes,
three fresh eggs,
15ml of refined vegetable oil,
3g of salt,
2g of white sugar,
and one green onion.
 
Synthesis Process:
Core the tomatoes and cut lengthwise,
slice into crescent-shaped wedges,
crack the eggs into a bowl,
beat the eggs until smooth,
finely chop the green onion and set aside,
place the pan over high heat,
coat the pan evenly with oil;
Once the oil is hot, pour in the egg mixture, gently swirl and spread flat;
Just before the eggs fully solidify, turn off the heat;
Transfer the naturally solidified egg pieces to a plate and set aside;
Return the pan to high heat, add the tomato wedges and stir-fry;
Sprinkle in the sugar and continue stir-frying
until the tomatoes soften and release a large amount of juice;
Return the egg pieces to the pan, add salt, reduce to low heat;
Gently toss everything together until the sauce evenly coats the egg pieces;
Once the sauce thickens slightly, turn off the heat, plate, and garnish with green onion.
 
Yes, this is nothing more than a recipe for Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry, the most ordinary of home-cooked dishes.
Perhaps you were expecting something else,
but, if you'll humor an old ramble from Arita...
No myths or legends can hold a candle to a simple recipe of a home-cooked dish.
O greatest of treasure hunters!
Do not let the Elation of others
lead your heart astray!
